# CAIR SPA

> CAIR SPA (Comprehensive Aesthetic Integrative Regeneration Spa) is a physician-supervised medical spa at 20951 Brookhurst St, Ste 115, Huntington Beach, CA 92646, serving all of Orange County. Phone (949) 688-5898. Hours Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM. Free consultations.

## Services
- [Botox](https://cairspa.com/services/botox)
- [Dermal Fillers](https://cairspa.com/services/dermal-fillers)
- [Signature Facial](https://cairspa.com/services/facial)
- [RF Microneedling](https://cairspa.com/services/rf-microneedling)
- [Thread Lift](https://cairspa.com/services/thread-lift)
- [IV Infusions](https://cairspa.com/services/iv-infusion)
- [Skin Rejuvenation](https://cairspa.com/services/skin-rejuvenation)

- [Weight Loss Injections](https://cairspa.com/services/weight-loss)
- [Exosome Therapy](https://cairspa.com/services/exosome-therapy)
- [NAD+ Therapy](https://cairspa.com/services/nad-therapy)
- [Hair Transplant ARTAS](https://cairspa.com/services/hair-transplant)
